title: Codex Computer use｜介紹與操作

sources.title: OpenAI launches Operator—an agent that can use a computer for you (MIT Technology Review)

principle.summary: 看→想→做循環（截圖→判斷→游標點擊／輸入→再截圖確認）；macOS 螢幕錄製＋輔助使用，Windows 需可見且接管前景輸入；先詢問、一律允許、不能操作終端機／ChatGPT、不能核准系統提示、敏感動作徵求同意、沙盒照常、網頁內容不可信。

scenes.title: 起源：讓 Codex 看得見螢幕
scenes.screen: 2026-04-16 Codex 推出 Computer use（先支援 macOS）
scenes.objective: 知道 Computer use 解決什麼問題，以及 2026-04-16 推出前後的里程碑。
scenes.narration: 有些工作，只有在畫面上才做得到：調整某個 App 的設定、檢查簡報排版，或重現只在介面上出現的錯誤。這時候，Codex 需要像人一樣看螢幕、動滑鼠。這就是 Computer use。這不是新想法。2025 年 1 月，OpenAI 推出 Operator，用截圖加上滑鼠與鍵盤，操作瀏覽器。2026 年 3 月 5 日，GPT-5.4 成為 Codex 裡第一個原生具備電腦操作能力的通用模型。接著在 2026 年 4 月 16 日，Codex 推出 Computer use，先支援 macOS 上的 App。5 月 29 日加入 Windows，6 月 16 日開放歐洲經濟區、英國與瑞士；7 月 9 日，Codex 併入 ChatGPT 桌面 App，Computer use 也變得更快。

scenes.title: 原理：看→想→做的循環
scenes.screen: 截圖看畫面 → 判斷下一步 → 點擊或輸入 → 再截圖確認
scenes.objective: 能說出看→想→做的循環，以及 macOS／Windows 需要的權限與條件。
scenes.narration: Computer use 是一個循環：先截圖，看清楚畫面；再判斷下一步，移動自己的游標點擊或輸入；做完再截一次圖，確認結果。一次動作不一定就完成，所以它會一直轉這個循環，直到工作完成，或停下來問你。在 macOS 上，它需要兩個系統權限：「螢幕錄製」是眼睛，讓它看得到 App；「輔助使用」是手，讓它能點擊、輸入和切換視窗。在 Windows 上，目標 App 必須留在桌面上看得到的地方，而且它會接管前景的滑鼠和鍵盤。

scenes.title: 原理：安全邊界
scenes.screen: 先詢問 · 一律允許清單 · 做不到的事 · 沙盒照常
scenes.objective: 知道它會先詢問、怎麼管理一律允許清單、有哪些做不到的事與需要在場確認的動作。
scenes.narration: 第一次要操作某個 App 時，它會先問你可不可以。選「一律允許」，之後就不再詢問；想收回，到設定的 Computer use 移除。有些事它做不到：不能操作終端機 App 和 ChatGPT 本身，也不能替你通過管理員驗證，或核准系統的安全與隱私權限提示。遇到敏感或有破壞性的動作，它可能先徵求你的同意；帳號、付款、密碼這類設定，官方建議你在場，逐步確認。另外，檔案編輯和 Shell 指令，仍然受原本的沙盒與核准設定管理。如果它操作瀏覽器，網頁內容可能藏著誤導的指示，要當成不可信的資料。

scenes.title: 比較：什麼時候用 Computer use？
scenes.screen: 同樣請 Codex 動手：指令、外掛／MCP、內建瀏覽器、Chrome 擴充、Computer use
scenes.objective: 能依任務在指令、外掛／MCP、內建瀏覽器、Chrome 擴充與 Computer use 之間選擇。
scenes.narration: 要 Codex 動手，不只 Computer use 一種方法。Shell 指令和檔案：結果能直接驗證，又快又穩，但只處理文字與檔案。外掛或 MCP：透過 App 的結構化介面直接拿資料，官方建議有就優先用。內建瀏覽器：用 @Browser 呼叫，適合預覽本機開發中的網頁，它用獨立的設定檔。Chrome 擴充：用 @Chrome，在你平常的瀏覽器分頁裡工作，沿用你的登入狀態。Computer use：任何 App 都能看、都能點，最通用；但要一張張截圖判斷，通常比較慢。所以順序是：能用指令或外掛就先用；網頁交給瀏覽器；真的只能靠眼睛判斷畫面時，再請 Computer use 出場。

scenes.title: 操作：開啟與呼叫
scenes.screen: 外掛程式 → Computer Use → 開關 → 系統授權 → @Computer
scenes.objective: 能照步驟開啟 Computer use、授權並用 @Computer 呼叫。
scenes.narration: 開始使用前，先在桌面 App 選 Codex，或在 ChatGPT 切到 Work。打開外掛程式，找到 Computer Use，按 Install plugin；如果顯示 Enable，就按 Enable。把 server 和 skill 兩個開關都打開，再按 Try now。macOS 會要求授權：到系統設定的「隱私權與安全性」，替 Codex Computer Use 打開螢幕錄製和輔助使用。要用的時候，在對話裡輸入 @Computer，或 @ 加上 App 名稱，再清楚說明要操作哪個 App、哪個視窗，做什麼事。第一次碰到某個 App，它會先詢問；你可以同意，或選 Always allow。到設定的 Computer use，可以管理能控制的 App：Any App 代表任何 App；Chrome 可以連接擴充功能，Excel 和 PowerPoint 可以用增益集，取得更多控制。如果是公司帳號，管理員可能關閉這個功能，或限制能用的 App。

scenes.title: 應用（示範）：逐頁檢查簡報
scenes.screen: 示範情境：問題 → 使用過程 → 結果 → 限制
scenes.objective: 看過一次從問題、過程到結果與限制的完整示範。
scenes.narration: 示範情境：你輸入「@Computer 打開期末報告簡報，逐頁檢查標題有沒有超出版面，有就縮小字級，最後回報」。它先請你允許操作簡報 App，接著逐頁截圖，找到第 3 頁和第 7 頁的標題超出版面。它點進標題框、調小字級，每改一頁，就再截圖確認一次。最後回報：12 頁裡修改了 2 頁，其餘正常。限制也要知道：在 Windows 上它會占用你的滑鼠和鍵盤，官方建議用第二台裝置、虛擬機，或先暫停任務，再自己操作。改好的檔案要存檔，而且在專案追蹤範圍內，變更才會出現在審閱面板。最後，請自己再翻一次：截圖判斷，也可能看錯。

scenes.title: 展望：下一步與未解問題
scenes.screen: 已公布 · 推測的趨勢 · 未解問題（截至 2026-10-09）
scenes.objective: 分得出已公布功能、推測趨勢與未解問題，並記住重點。
scenes.narration: 已公布的功能有：Locked use，Mac 鎖定後，遠端的任務仍能暫時解鎖、繼續操作，一偵測到本機的鍵盤或滑鼠，就立刻重新鎖定。Record & Replay：在 macOS 上示範一次流程，就把它變成可重複使用的 skill。我們推測，結構化整合會越來越多，Computer use 則負責補上沒有介面可接的最後一哩。還沒解決的問題：截圖判斷的可靠度、網頁和文件裡的提示注入，以及代理出錯時的責任歸屬。重點回顧：Computer use 用看、想、做的循環操作 App；先給權限，管好允許清單；能用指令、外掛或瀏覽器就先用，只有畫面才做得到的事，再交給它。

scenes.title: 起源：讓 Codex 看得見螢幕
scenes.screen: 2026-04-16 · Codex launches Computer use (macOS first)
scenes.objective: 知道 Computer use 解決什麼問題，以及 2026-04-16 推出前後的里程碑。
scenes.narration: Some jobs can only be done on screen: changing an app's settings, checking a slide layout, or reproducing a bug that only shows up in the interface. For these, Codex has to look at the screen and use a mouse, like a person. That is Computer use. The idea isn't new. In January 2025, OpenAI launched Operator, which used screenshots plus a mouse and keyboard to work a browser. On March 5, 2026, GPT-5.4 became the first general-purpose model in Codex with native computer use. Then, on April 16, 2026, Codex launched Computer use, starting with apps on macOS. Windows followed on May 29, and on June 16 it opened in the European Economic Area, the UK, and Switzerland. On July 9, Codex joined the ChatGPT desktop app, and Computer use became faster.

scenes.title: 原理：看→想→做的循環
scenes.screen: Screenshot → decide → click or type → check again
scenes.objective: 能說出看→想→做的循環，以及 macOS／Windows 需要的權限與條件。
scenes.narration: Computer use works in a loop: first, a screenshot to see the screen; then it decides the next step, and moves its own cursor to click or type; then another screenshot to check the result. One action is rarely enough, so it keeps going around the loop until the job is done, or it stops to ask you. On macOS it needs two system permissions. Screen Recording is the eyes, so it can see the app; Accessibility is the hands, so it can click, type, and move between windows. On Windows, the target app must stay visible on the desktop, and it takes over the foreground mouse and keyboard.

scenes.title: 原理：安全邊界
scenes.screen: Asks first · always-allowed list · hard limits · sandbox still applies
scenes.objective: 知道它會先詢問、怎麼管理一律允許清單、有哪些做不到的事與需要在場確認的動作。
scenes.narration: The first time it wants to use an app, it asks you first. Choose Always allow and it won't ask again; to undo that, remove the app under Computer use in Settings. Some things it cannot do: it can't automate terminal apps or ChatGPT itself, and it can't authenticate as an administrator or approve system security and privacy prompts. For sensitive or destructive actions, it may ask for permission first; for account, payment, or password settings, the docs recommend you stay present and approve step by step. File edits and shell commands are still governed by your sandbox and approval settings. And if it works in a browser, web pages may hide misleading instructions, so treat page content as untrusted.

scenes.title: 比較：什麼時候用 Computer use？
scenes.screen: Five ways to let Codex act: shell, plugins/MCP, built-in browser, Chrome extension, Computer use
scenes.objective: 能依任務在指令、外掛／MCP、內建瀏覽器、Chrome 擴充與 Computer use 之間選擇。
scenes.narration: Computer use isn't the only tool. There are other ways to let Codex act. Shell commands and files: results are easy to verify, fast and stable, but limited to text and files. Plugins or MCP: they reach an app's data through a structured interface, and the docs say to prefer them when they exist. The built-in browser: call it with @Browser. It suits local web apps in development, and uses a separate profile. The Chrome extension: call it with @Chrome. It works in your everyday browser tabs, with your existing sign-ins. Computer use: it can see and click any app, so it is the most general, but judging screenshot by screenshot is usually slower. So the order is: use commands or plugins when you can; give web pages to a browser; and bring in Computer use when the job truly needs eyes on the screen.

scenes.title: 操作：開啟與呼叫
scenes.screen: Plugins → Computer Use → toggles → OS permissions → @Computer
scenes.objective: 能照步驟開啟 Computer use、授權並用 @Computer 呼叫。
scenes.narration: To start, choose Codex in the desktop app, or switch ChatGPT to Work. Open Plugins, find Computer Use, and select Install plugin; if it shows Enable, select Enable. Turn on both the server and skill toggles, then select Try now. macOS will ask for permissions: in System Settings, under Privacy and Security, turn on Screen Recording and Accessibility for Codex Computer Use. To use it, type @Computer in the chat, or @ followed by the app's name, and say clearly which app, which window, and what to do. The first time it meets an app, it asks; you can agree, or choose Always allow. Under Computer use in Settings you manage which apps it may control: Any App means every app; Chrome can connect its extension, and Excel and PowerPoint can use add-ins for extra control. On a work account, an admin may turn the feature off or limit which apps it can use.

scenes.title: 應用（示範）：逐頁檢查簡報
scenes.screen: Demonstration: problem → process → result → limits
scenes.objective: 看過一次從問題、過程到結果與限制的完整示範。
scenes.narration: Here is a demonstration. You type: @Computer, open the final-report slides, check every page for titles that overflow, shrink them, and report back. It first asks permission to use the slides app, then takes a screenshot of each page, and finds that the titles on pages 3 and 7 overflow. It clicks into each title box, lowers the font size, and checks again with a fresh screenshot after every fix. Finally it reports: 2 of 12 pages changed, the rest are fine. Know the limits too. On Windows it takes over your mouse and keyboard, so the docs suggest a second device, a virtual machine, or pausing the task before you use the computer yourself. And changes only show up in the review pane once the file is saved and tracked by the project. Last, flip through it yourself: judging from screenshots can still be wrong.

scenes.title: 展望：下一步與未解問題
scenes.screen: Announced · inferred trend · open questions (as of 2026-10-09)
scenes.objective: 分得出已公布功能、推測趨勢與未解問題，並記住重點。
scenes.narration: Already announced: Locked use lets a remote task briefly unlock a locked Mac and keep working, and it locks again as soon as it detects local keyboard or mouse input. Record & Replay turns a workflow you demonstrate once on macOS into a reusable skill. Our inference: structured integrations will keep growing, while Computer use covers the last mile where no interface exists. Open questions remain: how reliable screenshot judgment is, prompt injection in pages and files, and who is responsible when an agent gets it wrong. To recap: Computer use runs apps with a see, decide, act loop; grant permissions, and keep your allow list tidy; use commands, plugins, or a browser first, and hand it only the jobs that truly need the screen.

You type: @Computer, open the final-report slides,
你輸入「@Computer 打開期末報告簡報，
check every page for titles that overflow, shrink them,
逐頁檢查標題有沒有超出版面，有就縮小字級，
and report back.
最後回報」。
It first asks permission to use the slides app,
它先請你允許操作簡報 App，
then takes a screenshot of each page,
接著逐頁截圖，
and finds that the titles on pages 3 and 7 overflow.
找到第 3 頁和第 7 頁的標題超出版面。
It clicks into each title box, lowers the font size,
它點進標題框、調小字級，
and checks again with a fresh screenshot after every fix.
每改一頁，就再截圖確認一次。
Finally it reports: 2 of 12 pages changed, the rest are fine.
最後回報：12 頁裡修改了 2 頁，其餘正常。
Know the limits too.
限制也要知道：
On Windows it takes over your mouse and keyboard,
在 Windows 上它會占用你的滑鼠和鍵盤，
so the docs suggest a second device, a virtual machine,
官方建議用第二台裝置、虛擬機，
or pausing the task before you use the computer yourself.
或先暫停任務，再自己操作。
And changes only show up in the review pane
改好的檔案要存檔，而且在專案追蹤範圍內，
once the file is saved and tracked by the project.
變更才會出現在審閱面板。
Last, flip through it yourself:
最後，請自己再翻一次：
judging from screenshots can still be wrong.
截圖判斷，也可能看錯。
Already announced: Locked use
已公布的功能有：Locked use，
lets a remote task briefly unlock a locked Mac and keep working,
Mac 鎖定後，遠端的任務仍能暫時解鎖、繼續操作，
and it locks again as soon as it detects local keyboard or mouse input.
一偵測到本機的鍵盤或滑鼠，就立刻重新鎖定。
Record & Replay turns a workflow you demonstrate once on macOS
Record & Replay：在 macOS 上示範一次流程，
into a reusable skill.
就把它變成可重複使用的 skill。
Our inference: structured integrations will keep growing,
我們推測，結構化整合會越來越多，
while Computer use covers the last mile where no interface exists.
Computer use 則負責補上沒有介面可接的最後一哩。
Open questions remain: how reliable screenshot judgment is,
還沒解決的問題：截圖判斷的可靠度、
prompt injection in pages and files,
網頁和文件裡的提示注入，
and who is responsible when an agent gets it wrong.
以及代理出錯時的責任歸屬。
To recap: Computer use runs apps with a see, decide, act loop;
重點回顧：Computer use 用看、想、做的循環操作 App；
grant permissions, and keep your allow list tidy;
先給權限，管好允許清單；
use commands, plugins, or a browser first,
能用指令、外掛或瀏覽器就先用，
and hand it only the jobs that truly need the screen.
只有畫面才做得到的事，再交給它。
